blogs.title: Intervention After Treating PVE: Timing and Risk Assessment for TAV-in-TAV-in-TAV
blogs.description: Explores the critical timing considerations for reintervening after Prosthetic Valve Endocarditis, discussing the transition from antimicrobial therapy to valve replacement and why shared decision-making is crucial in high-risk patients refusing or unfit for surgery.

blogs.title: The Functional Anatomy of Triple Stenting: Coronary Access Preservation
blogs.description: A technical deep-dive into maintaining coronary perfusion in patients with multiple transcatheter valves, analyzing high implantation strategies and the impact of frame-to-frame proximity on future access.

blogs.title: Read the Map: The Role of MSCT in Complex Valve Replacements
blogs.description: Highlights the evidentiary value of preoperative multislice CT in planning valve depth and landing zone, demonstrating how 3D modeling reduces the risk of coronary obstruction in serial TAV procedures.

blogs.title: Device Geometry in High-Impact Redo TAVI: Balloon vs. Self-Expanding
blogs.description: Examines the rationale behind selecting a self-expanding supra-annular valve (Acurate Neo2) over balloon-expandable options for complex triple-TAV anatomy and its biomechanical implications.

blogs.title: Reading the Hemodynamics: Interpreting Gradients Over the First Year
blogs.description: Analyzes the clinical course of serial valve replacement, focusing on the evolution of mean gradients and AVA post-intervention and what changes in these metrics imply for patient remodeling and valve function.

blogs.title: Passive Surveillance: Long-Term Management of Triple-Valve Anatomy
blogs.description: Discusses the long-term monitoring requirements for patients with serial transcatheter valve interventions, including the role of follow-up imaging and planning for potential future surgical salvage.
